author: Jin_Int
title: “Because for me, the meaning of life is embodied in the possibility for women to live freely.”
content: Dear comrades…  Bearers of the consciousness and work of Jineolojî, builders of a free life. Ever since childhood, I have carried within me a quest: to witness the liberation of women and to open up a space for them to live a life worthy of them.
